subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: The harness shall read verb bindings exclusively from the repo's verification manifest (closed schema — unknown keys are errors), with the shipped ecosystem defaults supplying bindings only for fields the manifest's declared stack leaves to them.
rationale: green's definition is frozen human-confirmed data, never a runtime guess
fit_criterion: a manifest with an unknown key fails closed-parse in fixtures; a minimal manifest on a common-stack fixture resolves the full verb set from defaults; removing the manifest yields configuration-error (UB-3), never a defaults-only run
